name: Ancient Data Storage Disc (CD/DVD)
purpose: Used to store digital information, music, or movies.
repurpose: Sharpen edges for a makeshift blade, use as a reflective signal mirror, or as a very durable coaster.

name: Personal Communication Device (Smartphone)
purpose: Enabled instant global communication, access to vast information networks, and entertainment.
repurpose: Battery might still hold a tiny charge for a spark, screen can be used as a small mirror, or as a very complex paperweight.

name: Pre-Fall Writing Implement (Pen)
purpose: Used for manual recording of information on paper.
repurpose: Can be used to poke small holes, as a makeshift lock-pick (with skill), or for its original purpose if ink remains.

name: Pre-Fall Information Compendium (Book/Magazine)
repurpose: Fuel for a small fire, insulation, toilet paper (if desperate), or a source of pre-apocalypse wisdom (if readable).

name: Preserved Sustenance Container (Canned Food)
purpose: Stored food for long periods, providing nutrition.
repurpose: Primary use is consumption. Empty can for water collection, makeshift cup, or a loud noise maker.

name: Hydration Vessel (Water Bottle)
purpose: Contained potable water for personal consumption.
repurpose: Collect and store water, makeshift filter (with fabric), or a simple signaling device.
